name: Add retry logic with exponential backoff and error filter
description: Implement withRetry with configurable maxRetries, exponential delay, and retryIf error predicate in src/retry.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, options?: RetryOptions): Promise<T> in src/retry.ts. Options: maxRetries (default 3), initialDelayMs (default 50), backoffFactor (default 2), and retryIf ((err: unknown) => boolean, default () => true). On attempt failure, check retryIf(err). If true and attempts remain, sleep for currentDelay (initialDelayMs * backoffFactor^(attempt-1)) before retrying. If attempts exhausted or retryIf is false, rethrow last error. All tests in test/retry.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: Resolves immediately on first attempt success
Retries on error up to maxRetries times with exponential delay
Stops retrying early if retryIf(err) returns false
Rethrows last error when retries exhausted
